goal: Enumeration and sweep of open-world evidence dimensions toward a ~100K-token per-asset dossier that compresses into a ~4K-token context4k.

dimensions.name: clothing/apparel
dimensions.hypothesis: Declared DOME-29 clothing/apparel measurements (coverage, garment classes, per-garment dominant colors) reduce unsupported clothing claims in captions on the frozen first-500 cohort.
dimensions.falsified_if: The clothing-evidence condition does not reduce unsupported clothing claims or increase supported claims versus its matched no-evidence baseline under fixed view/prompt/model/settings.
dimensions.deterministic_signal: seg2 DOME-29 Apparel(1)/Upper_Clothing(23)/Lower_Clothing(13)/Torso(22)/Socks/Shoes classes + per-class dominant color from source pixels
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort; seg2 + source pixels
dimensions.selection_rationale: Clothing is a high-frequency hallucination risk and is deterministically measurable from existing seg2+pixels with no new model.

specialists.name: Florence-2-Flux-Large
specialists.scope: open-set clothing/apparel attribute tagging (garment type, color) from source pixels
known_failure_modes: long-tail garment names may drift from source truth

dimensions.name: hair
dimensions.hypothesis: Declared hair measurements (color, area fraction, length proxy) reduce invented hair-color/coverage claims.
dimensions.falsified_if: The hair-evidence condition does not improve claim support versus its matched no-evidence baseline.
dimensions.deterministic_signal: seg2 Hair(4) region area/position + dominant color from source pixels
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort; seg2 + source pixels
dimensions.selection_rationale: Hair color/length is commonly hallucinated and is deterministically measurable from the existing Hair class.

dimensions.name: skin-color/tone
dimensions.hypothesis: Declared exposed-skin dominant color/tone reduces invented skin-tone claims.
dimensions.falsified_if: Skin-tone evidence does not improve supported claims or reduce unsupported color claims.
dimensions.deterministic_signal: seg2 Face_Neck(3)/limb skin regions + source pixel dominant color
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort; seg2 + source pixels
dimensions.selection_rationale: Skin tone is a frequent hallucination target and is measurable from existing seg2 masks.

dimensions.name: body-type/proportions
dimensions.hypothesis: Declared anthropometric ratios (shoulder:hip, torso:leg, limb lengths) improve body/limb description support.
dimensions.falsified_if: Proportion evidence does not improve supported body/pose claims over baseline.
dimensions.deterministic_signal: pose2 Goliath-308 keypoints (shoulder/hip/limb ratios) + seg2 region fractions
dimensions.selection_rationale: Pose evidence already improved claims in arm #4; body proportions are the direct extension using the same keypoints.

dimensions.name: lighting
dimensions.hypothesis: Declared luminance/dynamic-range/lighting-direction statistics reduce invented shadow/lighting claims.
dimensions.falsified_if: Lighting evidence does not reduce unsupported lighting claims.
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort; normal2 + source pixels
dimensions.selection_rationale: Lighting is a common soft-detail hallucination and is measurable from existing pixel/normal artifacts.

dimensions.name: setting/environment
dimensions.hypothesis: Declared background palette/non-subject statistics improve scene-environment claim support.
dimensions.falsified_if: Setting evidence does not improve supported scene claims or reduce invented background details.
dimensions.deterministic_signal: seg2 Background/non-subject region + source color palette
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort; seg2 + source pixels
dimensions.selection_rationale: Background is frequently over-described and is measurable from the existing seg2 Background class.

dimensions.name: texture/material
dimensions.hypothesis: Declared per-region texture proxies (edge/gradient statistics) reduce invented material/texture claims.
dimensions.falsified_if: Texture evidence does not improve support or reduce unsupported material claims.
dimensions.deterministic_signal: per-mask gradient/edge statistics from source pixels (e.g. gradient magnitude inside seg2 regions)
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort; seg2 + source pixels
dimensions.selection_rationale: Material/texture is a common hallucination and is measurable deterministically without new models.

specialists.name: Florence-2-large
specialists.scope: open-set material/texture/attribute description from source pixels
known_failure_modes: material attribution is confounded by lighting

dimensions.name: full-dossier assembly and context4k compression
dimensions.hypothesis: An expanded per-item dossier assembled from verified evidence dimensions (target >=100K tokens, claim-by-claim evidence links) can be compressed to a ~4K-token context4k artifact that preserves supported claims better than a plain 4K summarization baseline.
dimensions.falsified_if: context4k does not preserve supported claims at materially higher density than a 4K baseline summarization (round-trip claim-support audit not passed).
dimensions.deterministic_signal: Verified dimension specialists + relational determinations assembled per item
dimensions.selection_rationale: This is the program-level goal: ~100K descriptive tokens per asset compressed into ~4K context while keeping evidence links — beyond any single dimension.

specialists.name: ComfyUI reconstruction (SD1.5/SDXL/flux1Schnell)
specialists.scope: generate image from context4k/dossier; compare to source with CLIP ViT-L/14 similarity
known_failure_modes: generative model does not reproduce identity/subject exactly
CLIP score is a weak identity proxy
GPU time per item is large

dimensions.name: generative reconstruction validation (ComfyUI round-trip)
dimensions.hypothesis: Generative reconstruction is a valid, non-LLM measure of per-asset information preserved by a caption/context: images generated from a caption/context via local ComfyUI score higher in CLIP ViT-L/14 similarity against the original source than images generated from a degraded baseline (e.g. no context / truncated context), so reconstruction can validate the 100K->4K dossier pipeline independently of claim-support review.
dimensions.falsified_if: Reconstruction similarity does not correlate with information content (a fixed 4K context cannot be distinguished from a truncated/baseline context by CLIP score), or the diffusion checkpoint fails to decode the relevant attributes at all (ceiling effect / degenerate similarity).
dimensions.deterministic_signal: CLIP ViT-L/14 similarity (source vs generated-from-context4k, and source vs generated-from-degraded-baseline) via local ComfyUI over frozen diffusion checkpoints
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort; local ComfyUI at /mnt/fscache/essdee/ComfyUI; 195 diffusion checkpoints at /mnt/nas-ai-models/checkpoints; CLIP ViT-L/14 openai/clip-vit-large-patch14 + timm/vit_large_patch14_clip_224.openai in HF cache
dimensions.selection_rationale: Claim-support review (gemma4/LLM) is the current sole downstream check on caption/PENDING dossier quality. Reconstruction adds a generation-grounded, non-LLM, end-to-end test that an independent reviewer cannot substitute for, and directly measures the top-level goal (context that regenerates the asset) rather than only claim agreement. It also exercises the underused local ComfyUI + NAS checkpoint inventory.
dimensions.scope: generative reconstruction of source images from dossier/context artifacts; CLIP ViT-L/14 similarity of generated vs source and vs degraded-baseline generations
dimensions.inputs: context4k.json / context4k.md / compression.json artifacts + source image (read-only canonical), frozen ComfyUI pipeline + one frozen diffusion checkpoint
dimensions.output_semantics: per-item CLIP ViT-L/14 cosine similarity (generated vs source); delta between context-driven and baseline generations; scale-invariant to camera framing
dimensions.provenance: local ComfyUI at /mnt/fscache/essdee/ComfyUI (.venv python3.14, torch 2.12+cu130); checkpoints at /mnt/nas-ai-models/checkpoints (SD1.5, SDXL, flux1Schnell, sd3, pony, SUPIR); CLIP ViT-L/14 openai/clip-vit-large-patch14 and timm/vit_large_patch14_clip_224.openai in HF cache
dimensions.abstention_policy: reject generations failing sanity checks (empty/discarded generation, sampler error, degenerate output); abstain when the diffusion checkpoint fails to decode relevant attributes (ceiling effect) and report it, never treating failure as a BETTER signal
dimensions.qualification_gate: PASS only after: (a) a frozen cohort and fixed ComfyUI checkpoint + sampler/generation settings; (b) a controlled one-axis comparison (full context vs baseline) scoring original vs generated with a fixed CLIP ViT-L/14 model; (c) calibration of the scoring on known cases and a null case (empty/meaningless prompt); (d) independent review of the reconstruction protocol; and (e) no corpus mutation, local-first, scheduler-managed GPU, noncanonical output only, additive artifacts only.
known_failure_modes: generative model does not reproduce identity/subject exactly
CLIP score is a weak identity proxy
GPU time per item is large
ceiling effect / degenerate similarity can make DELTA uninformative

specialists.name: ComfyUI reconstruction (SD1.5/SDXL/flux1Schnell)
specialists.scope: generate image from context4k/dossier; compare to source with CLIP ViT-L/14 similarity
known_failure_modes: generative model does not reproduce identity/subject exactly
CLIP score is a weak identity proxy
GPU time per item is large

dimensions.name: open-weight VLM dense multi-view description
dimensions.hypothesis: A locally-run open-weight VLM producing a dense, multi-view descriptive block for a single curated woman source image (full-frame + seg2-derived focal crops), routed claim-by-claim with abstention, materially raises supported-claim density on the frozen 24-item cohort versus the deterministic dossier alone, and is a legitimately-new evidence part toward the 100K expanded-dossier floor (option B of decision #46).
dimensions.falsified_if: The VLM dense description does not raise supported-claim density on the frozen cohort beyond the deterministic dossier + honest-expansion ceiling, or abstains at too low a rate to be trustworthy (unchecked verbosity), or is not distinguishable from a redundant attribute-tagger over already-validated axes.
dimensions.deterministic_signal: learned VLM dense description (MODEL FLIP 2026-08-06: qwen3-vl:32b FAILED qualification on the real corpus — silent empty responses on both vision and plain text, server-side decode wedge not restartable without root; production evidence producer is now gemma3:27b local Ollama digest a418f5838eaf on Strix, verified to emit the full tagged 6-subsection block on corpus items; qwen3.5-9b Mar 2026 Apache-2.0 remains a newer single-GPU candidate) over full-frame + focal crops; each claim tagged observed/inferred/abstained; scale-invariant ratios only in prose
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort; source pixels + seg2 crop regions; local Ollama/ComfyUI stack
dimensions.selection_rationale: The arm-36 honest expansion-ceiling audit proved deterministic evidence tops out at 2040-3489 tokens/item (7-50x below the 100K floor); a VLM dense-description specialist is the concrete option-B evidence source named in decision #46 and is a NEW evidence part per the open-world sourcing directive (local options exhausted).
dimensions.scope: dense multi-view descriptive prose for a single curated woman source image: full-frame + focal crops (face, upper body, garment regions derived from seg2); evidence prose, not a caption
dimensions.inputs: decoded source RGB full-frame + fixed focal crops derived from seg2 regions; frozen prompt
dimensions.output_semantics: structured markdown block of dense descriptive claims (subject, garments, hair, skin, setting, pose, facial detail), each claim tagged observed/inferred/abstained; no absolute pixel or raw-coordinate numbers in prose; scale-invariant ratios only; machine-readable measurements stay in evidence_payload JSON
dimensions.provenance: open weights run on owned hardware only (local 4090 via scheduler or Strix). Literature scan 2026-08-06: Molmo/Molmo-72B (AI2, fully open weights+data, PixMo dense-caption pretraining, top captioning benchmark; arXiv 2409.17146); Qwen2-VL-72B/Qwen2.5-VL (open weight, strongest MMMU/OCRBench); InternVL3-78B (MIT license). No hosted third-party inference of the sensitive corpus.
dimensions.abstention_policy: frozen prompt + deterministic crop policy; emit [ABSTAIN] on regions with insufficient visible pixels (motion blur/occlusion/DOF crop); detector/measurement disagreement is a quality anomaly, never content; no absolute pixel claim in prose
dimensions.qualification_gate: PASS only after: (a) frozen crop/prompt/view policy with pinned digests; (b) controlled document-utility check reproducing every fact deterministic specialists already declare on a known case AND adding materially more supported claims on the frozen 24-item cohort (claim-support rubric v1, same reviewer); (c) calibration on known cases + null case; (d) abstention audit (observed/inferred/abstained rates, unchecked verbosity is a fail); (e) independent adversarial review of the protocol; (f) no corpus mutation, local-first, scheduler-managed GPU, noncanonical output only, additive artifacts only.

dimensions.name: point-map / 3D depth-ordering
dimensions.hypothesis: Declared point-map relative-depth ordering measurements (foreground/background plane separation, occlusion structure, subject-depth ordering) reduce unsupported depth/occlusion/foreground-background claims in captions on the frozen 24-item cohort.
dimensions.falsified_if: The pointmap-depth evidence condition does not reduce unsupported depth/occlusion claims or increase supported claims versus its matched no-evidence baseline under fixed view/prompt/model/settings, or the measured depth-order is not distinguishable from the seg2-background plane (redundant axis).
dimensions.deterministic_signal: pointmap.npy per-pixel 3D points (CAM frame) + seg2 region masks: relative depth ordering, subject-vs-background plane separation ratio, self-occlusion/overlap structure from point-depth discontinuity at region boundaries
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort (24/24 frozen items have source-matched pointmap.npy + seg2.npy); pointmap is a core-chain artifact not bound by any validated arm
dimensions.selection_rationale: Point-map is a genuinely-new evidence surface (relative 3D structure/occlusion) present on 24/24 frozen items yet not bound as an evidence input by any validated arm; deterministic, zero new model, low cost, directly grows the dossier depth/foreground-background evidence axis.
dimensions.scope: deterministic per-item point-map depth-ordering measurement: relative depth order of seg2 regions, subject/background plane separation strength, occlusion structure between subject parts; scale-invariant ratios and depth-order relations only, never absolute metric distances in prose
dimensions.inputs: frozen pointmap.npy (source-matched) + seg2.npy region masks + pose2.npy keypoints; read-only canonical/derived artifacts
dimensions.output_semantics: depth-order relations + scale-invariant separation/overlap ratios, machine-readable in evidence_payload; prose carries only scale-invariant ordering claims (e.g. 'subject clearly separated from background', 'limb occludes torso')
dimensions.provenance: deterministic, computed in-memory from existing core artifacts (pointmap.npy is source-dimension-matched float16 3D point field); no new model, no corpus mutation, noncanonical output only
dimensions.abstention_policy: abstain when pointmap is absent/ill-formed or degenerate (zero extent), when scale is degenerate (subject fills frame such that no plane separation is measurable), or pose2 detector count != exactly one; detector/measurement disagreement is a quality anomaly, never content
dimensions.qualification_gate: PASS only after: (a) frozen plan + SHA-bound pointmap/seg2/pose2 evidence inputs; (b) band-calibration probe on the frozen cohort before freeze (no band >=75%); (c) controlled claim-support round-trip vs matched no-evidence baseline; (d) calibration on known cases + null case; (e) independent adversarial review; (f) no corpus mutation, local-first, scheduler-managed GPU, noncanonical output only.

dimensions.name: matting / alpha-fidelity
dimensions.hypothesis: Declared matting/alpha measurements (subject coverage ratio, soft-edge band width, hair/fine-feature delimiter structure, silhouette closedness) reduce unsupported edge-quality/hair/silhouette claims in captions on the frozen 24-item cohort.
dimensions.falsified_if: The matting evidence condition does not reduce unsupported edge-quality/fine-feature claims or increase supported claims versus its matched no-evidence baseline, or the measured alpha structure is not distinguishable from seg2 region coverage (redundant axis).
dimensions.deterministic_signal: matting.npy per-pixel soft alpha (source-matched) + seg2 masks + source pixels: subject alpha-integral coverage, soft-edge band width, hair/fine-detail delimiter energy, silhouette closedness
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort (24/24 frozen items have source-matched matting.npy); matting is a core-chain artifact not bound by any validated arm
dimensions.selection_rationale: Matting is a genuinely-new surface (per-pixel alpha fidelity: edge softness, hair/non-silhouette detail) present on 24/24 frozen items yet unbound by validated arms; deterministic, zero new model, low cost, feeds the dossier edge-quality evidence axis.
dimensions.scope: deterministic per-item matting measurement: subject alpha coverage ratio, soft-edge band width, hair/fine-feature delimiter structure, silhouette closedness; scale-invariant ratios/bands only in prose
dimensions.inputs: frozen matting.npy (source-matched) + seg2.npy masks + source pixels for edge color grounding; read-only canonical/derived artifacts
dimensions.output_semantics: subject-coverage ratio, soft-edge band width, edge-structure health bands, machine-readable in evidence_payload; prose carries only scale-invariant fidelity claims (e.g. 'soft detachable hair strands', 'sharp clean silhouette')
dimensions.provenance: deterministic, computed in-memory from existing core artifacts (matting.npy is source-dimension-matched float16 alpha); no new model, no corpus mutation, noncanonical output only
dimensions.abstention_policy: abstain when matting is absent/ill-formed or degenerate (all-one/all-zero alpha), or pose2 detector count != exactly one; detector/measurement disagreement is a quality anomaly, never content
dimensions.qualification_gate: PASS only after: (a) frozen plan + SHA-bound matting/seg2 evidence inputs; (b) band-calibration probe on the frozen cohort before freeze (no band >=75%); (c) controlled claim-support round-trip vs matched no-evidence baseline; (d) calibration on known cases + null case; (e) independent adversarial review; (f) no corpus mutation, local-first, scheduler-managed GPU, noncanonical output only.

dimensions.name: facial detail / face-shape geometry
dimensions.hypothesis: A locally-run open-weight facial-landmark model plus deterministic facial-geometry ratios (eye spacing:face width, facial thirds, mouth-width:face ratio) reduce unsupported facial-detail claims in captions on the frozen 24-item cohort.
dimensions.falsified_if: The face-geometry evidence condition does not reduce unsupported facial-detail claims or increase supported claims versus its matched no-evidence baseline, or the landmark model fails qualification on real corpus items (high abstention, missing faces).
dimensions.deterministic_signal: learned 478-point facial landmarks (mediapipe-facemesh-3d-class candidate, Apache-2.0 on-device) + deterministic facial ratios (eye-spacing/face-width, facial-thirds, mouth/face, jawline widths) — scale-invariant only
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort; face crop derived from seg2 Face_Neck region; local 4090/Strix
dimensions.selection_rationale: Facial DETAIL (eye shape/size/spacing, nose/lip geometry, face shape) is a high-frequency hallucination axis not covered by any validated arm (hair covers region+color, skin-color covers tone); local deterministic options exhausted (pose2 GOLIATH-308 has only coarse facial keypoints), so this is the open-world NEW-model-class path per the sourcing directive.
dimensions.scope: local open-weight facial-landmark/geometry model over the seg2 Face_Neck crop, emitting facial-geometry ratios and landmark-confirmed observable feature claims; scale-invariant only in prose
dimensions.inputs: face crop derived from seg2 Face_Neck region, frozen crop/prompt policy, decoded source RGB; local inference on owned hardware
dimensions.output_semantics: facial geometry ratios + landmark-confirmed observable feature claims, each tagged observed/abstained; no absolute px or raw-coordinate numbers in prose (scale-invariant ratios only)
dimensions.provenance: open weights run on owned hardware only (local 4090 via scheduler or Strix). Literature scan 2026-08-06: MediaPipe Face Mesh (Apache-2.0, standard on-device 478-point 3D mesh; output x/y normalized, z relative scale); alternatives (DAD-3DHeads, face alignment NN) noted for comparison. No hosted third-party inference of the sensitive corpus.
dimensions.abstention_policy: frozen crop/prompt policy; emit [ABSTAIN] on insufficient face pixels (turned head, occlusion, extreme DOF, ambiguous makeup); no absolute pixel claim in prose; detector/measurement disagreement is a quality anomaly, never content
dimensions.qualification_gate: PASS only after: (a) frozen crop/prompt policy with pinned digests; (b) capability probe on local stack (non-sensitive verification) BEFORE trusting the producer; (c) controlled claim-support round-trip on the frozen 24-item cohort vs matched no-evidence baseline; (d) calibration on known cases + null; (e) independent adversarial review + abstention audit (unchecked verbosity is a fail); (f) no corpus mutation, local-first, scheduler-managed GPU, noncanonical output only.

dimensions.name: object / accessory presence + spatial relations
dimensions.hypothesis: A locally-run open-weight text-grounded object detector over a frozen closed vocabulary (furniture/props/held-objects/accessories) emitting object presence + normalized spatial relations reduces unsupported object-claim and background-object hallucination in captions on the frozen 24-item cohort.
dimensions.falsified_if: The object-relations evidence condition does not reduce unsupported object claims or increase supported claims versus its matched no-evidence baseline, or the detector fails qualification on real corpus items.
dimensions.deterministic_signal: learned open-vocabulary text-grounded detection (grounding-dino-open-vocab class candidate, Apache-2.0) over full-frame source with a frozen closed vocabulary; object presence + coarse bounding-box spatial relations, scale-invariant only in prose
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort; full-frame decoded source RGB; local 4090/Strix (HF Transformers path)
dimensions.selection_rationale: No validated arm measures discrete objects/accessories (setting #34 measures background palette/bands, not objects); this is the relational/interaction axis the brainstorm explicitly widens toward; local deterministic options exhausted (DOME_29 has no fine object classes), so it is the open-world NEW-model-class arm.
dimensions.scope: local open-weight text-grounded object detector over full-frame source, frozen closed vocabulary (furniture/props/held-objects/accessory classes), emitting object-presence + normalized spatial relations to the subject
dimensions.inputs: full-frame decoded source RGB; frozen closed vocabulary; local inference on owned hardware
dimensions.output_semantics: object presence list + normalized spatial relations (e.g. 'object left of subject / large in frame / behind subject'), each tagged detected/abstained; no absolute px in prose; machine-readable boxes stay in evidence_payload JSON
dimensions.provenance: open weights run on owned hardware only (local 4090 via scheduler or Strix). Literature scan 2026-08-06: Grounding DINO (Apache-2.0 open-vocabulary detection, arbitrary objects from free-form text, HF Transformers path). No hosted third-party inference of the sensitive corpus.
dimensions.abstention_policy: frozen vocabulary + detection threshold; emit [ABSTAIN] on low-confidence/occluded detections; never fabricate an object that is not detected; detector/measurement disagreement is a quality anomaly, never content
dimensions.qualification_gate: PASS only after: (a) frozen vocabulary/prompt/threshold with pinned digests; (b) capability probe on local stack (non-sensitive verification) BEFORE trusting the producer; (c) controlled claim-support round-trip on the frozen 24-item cohort vs matched no-evidence baseline; (d) calibration on known cases + null; (e) independent adversarial review + abstention audit; (f) no corpus mutation, local-first, scheduler-managed GPU, noncanonical output only.

dimensions.name: pose-articulation / kinematic constraints
dimensions.hypothesis: Declared kinematic articulation measurements (per-joint flexion angles, torso/pelvis orientation, contrapposto/weight-bearing stance, limb-overlap structure, symmetry ratios) reduce unsupported pose/stance/limb claims in captions on the frozen 24-item cohort.
dimensions.falsified_if: The pose-articulation evidence condition does not reduce unsupported pose/stance/limb claims or increase supported claims versus its matched no-evidence baseline, or the measured kinematics are not distinguishable from body-type's static ratios (redundant axis).
dimensions.deterministic_signal: pose2 GOLIATH-308 keypoints + seg2 masks: joint-angle ranges (elbow/knee flexion), torso/pelvis orientation from keypoint triangles, contrapposto/weight-bearing detection, limb-overlap count, symmetry/asymmetry ratios
dimensions.selection_rationale: Body-type #32 measures anthropometric RATIOS but not articulated kinematics (joint angles, stance, weight-bearing, limb overlap); deterministic from existing pose2+seg2 with zero new model, low cost, feeds the dossier pose/stance evidence axis.
dimensions.scope: deterministic articulation measurement: per-joint angles, torso/pelvis orientation from keypoint triangles, contrapposto/weight-bearing detection, limb-overlap count from seg2 masks, symmetry/asymmetry ratios; scale-invariant only in prose
dimensions.inputs: frozen pose2.npy (GOLIATH-308) + seg2.npy; read-only canonical/derived artifacts
dimensions.output_semantics: kinematic ratios/angles + stance class + overlap structure, machine-readable in evidence_payload; prose carries only scale-invariant relations (e.g. 'weight on one leg', 'bent arms') verifiable from ratios
dimensions.provenance: deterministic, computed in-memory from existing core artifacts (pose2 GOLIATH-308 keypoints + seg2 region masks); no new model, no corpus mutation, noncanonical output only
dimensions.abstention_policy: abstain where joint confidence is too low, limbs are cropped at frame edge, weight-bearing signal is ambiguous, or pose2 detector count != exactly one; detector/measurement disagreement is a quality anomaly, never content
dimensions.qualification_gate: PASS only after: (a) frozen plan + SHA-bound pose2/seg2 evidence inputs; (b) band-calibration probe on the frozen cohort before freeze; (c) controlled claim-support round-trip vs matched no-evidence baseline; (d) calibration on known cases + null case; (e) independent adversarial review (incl. distinguishability from body-type's static ratios); (f) no corpus mutation, local-first, scheduler-managed GPU, noncanonical output only.

dimensions.name: gaze / head-orientation (camera-interaction)
dimensions.hypothesis: A locally-run estimator over the already-installed MediaPipe FaceLandmarker 478-point mesh emitting scale-invariant gaze/head-orientation bands (facing camera, turned away, head up/down, profile) reduces unsupported camera-interaction claims and increases supported relational claims in captions on the frozen 24-item cohort.
dimensions.falsified_if: The gaze/head-orientation evidence condition does not reduce unsupported camera-interaction claims or increase supported claims versus its matched no-evidence baseline, or the face mesh fails qualification on real corpus items (high abstention / degenerate orientation), or an apparent difference is attributable to an uncontrolled change.
dimensions.deterministic_signal: reuses the validated MediaPipe FaceLandmarker mesh (owned hardware, local CPU, already installed from arm #60); scale-invariant head-orientation bands computed from 3D landmark geometry, never absolute pixels
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort; full-frame decoded source RGB + seg2; local 4090 (MediaPipe tasks API)
dimensions.selection_rationale: No validated arm measures gaze/head orientation relative to the camera (face-geometry #60 measures shape bands only). Camera interaction ('looking directly at the camera', 'head turned away') is a recurring caption claim with no deterministic support. This is the relational/interaction axis the brainstorm demands (a NEW evidence part, not an attribute-tagger over a validated axis).
dimensions.scope: Scale-invariant head-orientation bands from the existing MediaPipe FaceLandmarker 478-point mesh over the full frame / seg2 Face_Neck crop (union policy, arm #60): head yaw band (facing camera / partially turned / profile or turned away), head pitch band (level / down / up), with a plausibility/abstention gate.
dimensions.inputs: full-frame decoded source RGB + seg2.npy (DOME-29 Face_Neck mask); already-installed MediaPipe FaceLandmarker 'face_landmarker.task' (owned hardware, local CPU, tasks API)
dimensions.output_semantics: scale-invariant gaze/head-orientation bands, each tagged detected/abstained; raw yaw/pitch angles and mesh z-coords stay in evidence_payload JSON, never prose (camera-frame-relative but direction is invariant under scale)
dimensions.provenance: research_harness.face_geometry MediaPipe FaceLandmarker mesh (Apache-2.0, local CPU, owned hardware; model face_landmarker.task sha256 64184e229b...) — same asset validated in arm #60; computed in memory with no corpus write; no hosted third-party inference
dimensions.abstention_policy: frozen thresholds + human-plausibility gate; abstain with surfaced reason on no-face / degenerate mesh (arm #60 union policy: 21/24 detected, 3 honest abstains); never fabricate a gaze direction; detector disagreement is a quality anomaly, never content
dimensions.qualification_gate: PASS only after: (a) frozen thresholds/prompt pinned; (b) capability + band-calibration probe on the frozen cohort (no band >= 75%); (c) controlled claim-support round-trip vs matched no-evidence baseline; (d) calibration on known cases + null; (e) independent adversarial review + abstention audit; (f) no corpus mutation, local-first, scheduler-managed GPU.

dimensions.name: semantic scene category (CLIP zero-shot)
dimensions.hypothesis: A locally-run open-weight CLIP ViT-L/14 zero-shot classifier over a frozen closed scene-category set (indoor studio, plain wall backdrop, bedroom, living room, outdoor beach, outdoor garden, outdoor field, body of water, urban street, poolside) emitting a confident semantic scene label reduces unsupported background/scene claims and increases supported scene claims versus its matched no-evidence baseline on the frozen 24-item cohort.
dimensions.falsified_if: The scene-category evidence condition does not reduce unsupported background/scene claims or increase supported claims versus its matched no-evidence baseline, or the classifier fails qualification on real corpus items (low confidence, random labels), or an apparent difference is attributable to an uncontrolled change.
dimensions.deterministic_signal: open-weight zero-shot classification (openai/clip-vit-large-patch14, already in the local HF cache via arm #37; MIT/open weight, owned hardware). Frozen closed label set + prompt prefix + temperature; scale-invariant label only
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort; full-frame decoded source RGB; local CPU (harness venv + cached CLIP ViT-L/14)
dimensions.selection_rationale: Setting #34 measures background coverage/palette/bands but never the semantic WHAT-KIND-OF-PLACE (indoor studio vs outdoor beach vs poolside). Scene category is a genuinely-new SEMANTIC axis and a NEW model class.
